title: Cosine Sum or Difference formulas
text: Recall that $$cos\left(A+B\right)$$ $$=$$ cos(A)cos(B) - sin(A)sin(B) and $$cos(A-B)$$ $$=$$ cos(A)cos(B) + sin(A)sin(B).

title: Introduce tangent terms
text: To transform the expression into terms involving tan(a)tan(b), divide every term in the numerator and denominator by cos(a)cos(B).

title: Simplify to tangent form
text: Use the identity tan(x) $$=$$ $$\fracsin^c\left(x\right)os\left(x\right)}$$ to simplify the expression.
